notes.title: Iteration 3 - Update #9: August 31st, 2025
notes.content:
[p]On a technicality of beginning this update before midnight on August 31st, this is totally on time still ;)[/p][p align="start"][b]GOOD EVENING[/b] everyone! With this new update, we officially have concluded our Summer 2025 Roadmap! There's been plenty of long hours writing the finer points and details of Act 2 throughout the Summer, setting the stage for the Intermission 2 section we'll be completing in the coming weeks. For now though, a bit of a break is sorely needed; if my wrist has any say in it that is... (Act 2 is totaled at 155 Pages)[/p][p align="start"]Below is a look back at everything I have tasked myself during our Summer Season.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][i]June:[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]July:[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]August:[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]- The entirety of Intermission 1 at 100% Completion
- Started Act 2
- Published 2 Updates throughout the month[/p][/td][td][p]- Act 2 at 50% Completion
- Published 2 Updates throughout the month[/p][/td][td][p]- The entirety of Act 2 at 100% Completion
- Started Intermission 2
- Completed all tasks in Summer 2025 Roadmap
- Currently typing the remainder of this update![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]Three Months. 1 Minor, and 1 Major chunk of the story's story script completed. The overall outline of how the remainder of the story and how the features within the game will shape the project going forward are all but finalized in writing (which is always subject to change!) [/p][p align="start"]A new season brings new beginnings, and it is my absolute pleasure to present the OFFICIAL roadmap for the Fall 2025 Season![/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][i]September:[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]October:[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]November:[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]- 10% Completion of "Intermission 2" by "Update #10"
- 25% Completion of "Intermission 2" by "Update #11"
- Update #10: September 17th, 2025
- Update #11: September 30th, 2025[/p][/td][td][p]- 50% Completion of "Intermission 2" by "Update #12"
- 75% Completion of "Intermission 2" by "Update #13"
- Update #12: October 15th, 2025
- Update #13: October  30th, 2025[/p][/td][td][p]- 100% Completion of "Intermission 2" by "Update #14"
- Begin "Act 3" by "Update #15"
- Create "Winter 2025 Roadmap" in "Update #15"
- Update #14: November 12th, 2025
- Update #15: November  27th, 2025[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]Now, I am nothing if not generous towards my own mental health...sometimes.[/p][p align="start"]Do I believe Intermission 2 will take over 2 Months to complete? FUCK NO. Am I re-entering University later this week? YES. This is potentially my final year of University before I graduate, therefore I decided to be extra generous with the deadlines for the first 2 Months of the Fall 2025 Roadmap. [/p][p align="start"]If there are any "Early Completions" of any tasks on this To-Do List, they will NOT be bundled with the tasks in the given month. In its place, I'll be listing the date of Early Completion next to the task!
(EX: 50% of Intermission 2 won't be transferred to September upon Early Completions)
(- 50% Completion of "Intermission 2" by "Update #12"  Early Completion: Update #10 - September 17th, 2025)[/p][p align="start"]With the story of VOIDWATCH: CrossLust coming so close to completion, it gives me pause. This project has been in development hell since it's early ideas in 2021, and the original Alpha Build created in 2022. Since then, there have been several changes ranging from the fundamentals of the story & overall game, to the complete reworking of specific characters, settings, and abilities. Even how I have begun conducting myself and this project this year GREATLY differ from the early days of CrossLust. Many necessary mistakes had to be made along the way, such is life.[/p][p align="start"]That'll be all from me tonight! I hate the heat, and will embrace the chilly weather on the horizon. We'll be seeing you all when the next progress update on [b][i]September 17th, 2025 for Update #10 [/i][/b]has been published![/p][p align="start"][b][i]- Lance Leeder (DevLanket)[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Iteration 3 - Update #8: August 16th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Good evening everyone! I never typically enjoyed the summer all that much. These heatwaves have made time between work dreadful, luckily for me I still had time to work on this project. (Despite all the sweat.) Today marks the middle of August, and yet another [b][i]VOIDWATCH: CrossLust[/i][/b] update. Here's where we are in the roadmap:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][i]To Do: June[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: July[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: August[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][strike]- Begin "Intermission" Section
- Iteration 3 - Update #4: June 15th, 2025
- 25% Completion of "Intermission" by "Update #5" 
- 75% Completion of "Intermission" by "Update #7" 
- 100% Completion of "Intermission" by "Update #8" 
- Begin "Act 2" Section 
- Iteration 3 - Update #5: June 30th, 2025[/strike][/p][/td][td][p][strike]- 25% Completion of "Act 2" by "Update #6"
- Iteration 3 - Update #6: July 13th 2025
- 50% Completion of "Act 2" by "Update #7"
- Iteration 3 - Update #7: July 31st 2025[/strike][/p][/td][td][p][strike]- Iteration 3 - Update #8: August 16th 2025[/strike]
- 100% Completion of "Act 2" by "Update #9"
- Begin "Intermission 2" Section by "Update #9"
- Create the next roadmap in Update #9
(September, October, November)
- Iteration 3 - Update #9: August 31st 2025[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p align="start"]As of this moment, I am just reaching the end of Page 108 of Act 2's narrative. To give you some perspective, our last update was on Page 84. While we are well past 50% completion, I am unhappy with the current progress. I believe I've been experiencing some burnout due to complications in my personal life paired with the feelings of never having enough time to do everything. Rest assured, I have taken the necessary precautions; especially since I am about to enter another semester of University in September.[/p][p align="start"]Act 2 will be completed by the month's end, and progress towards Intermission 2 will begin immediately afterward. This will be the final update before the end of the Summer 2025 Roadmap concludes. Expect a look back at the progress made from Update #3 to Update #9, as well as the Fall 2025 Roadmap. This decision to reiterate the entire game once again, despite feelings of self-doubt; I am fully confident that it was the correct decision. Truth be told, I have no idea when this game will be ready for release. The earliest I can possibly say is Q3 of 2026, and that's IF everything goes to plan, but we all know that in this line of work; it never does the first time around.[/p][p align="start"]I wanted to take the opportunity to be more personal with these updates as, I'm sure it's pretty anticlimactic when I can't spoil the details about the story itself in these updates; so I hope a look into my mind during these development and design periods is a good substitute. Thank you for making it this far! I look forward to seeing you all when the next progress update on[b][i] August 31st, 2025 for Update #9 [/i][/b]has been published![/p][p align="start"][b][i]- Lance Leeder (DevLanket)[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Iteration 3 - Update #7: July 31st, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Good afternoon everyone! I hope everyone is doing fantastic despite the consistent heatwaves. We have made it to the end of July, which marks 2/3rds of the summer have come and gone as well as yet another [b][i]VOIDWATCH: CrossLust[/i][/b] update![/p][p]Act 2 has turned out to be a longer journey and experience than Act 1, with 84 Pages of details and content we have surpassed the 50% mark of completion, however not by very much. We are on track to completing Act 2 before the end of August if we keep this pace up.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][i]To Do: June[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: July[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: August[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][strike]- Begin "Intermission" Section

(September, October, November)
- Iteration 3 - Update #9: August 31st 2025[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]One thing worthy to note, is that despite the narrative driven experience Act 2 promotes exploration at the player's own pace with planned side quests, and hidden items that can be collected. I don't want to give too much away, but know this: the end of the story is not the end of the game.[/p][p]The countdown until the expected completion of Act 2 has begun, so has the countdown to the end of the Summer Season of the Roadmap. Stay tuned for the next progress update on[b][i] August 16th, 2025 for Update #8![/i][/b] [/p][p][b][i]- Lance Leeder (DevLanket)[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Iteration 3 - Update #6: July 13th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]We are already nearing the halfway point of July! I swear it feels that this year is just flying by without a care in the world. Welcome to another update for [b][i]VOIDWATCH: CrossLust[/i][/b]! Hope everyone has been keeping cool in this unbearable heat.[/p][p]I am utilizing a smaller journal for this portion of the script, however as of last night we have just passed the 25% Completion milestone; at least what I currently deem as 25%. Depending on how the remainder of the writing goes, we could realistically be at 30%, but it's too soon to say for certain. Below is the updated Roadmap as of today.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][i]To Do: June[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: July[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: August[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][strike]- Begin "Intermission" Section

- 75% Completion of "Intermission" by "Update #7" 
- 100% Completion of "Intermission" by "Update #8" 
- Begin "Act 2" Section 
- Iteration 3 - Update #5: June 30th, 2025[/strike][/p][/td][td][p][strike]- 25% Completion of "Act 2" by "Update #6"
- Iteration 3 - Update #6: July 13th 2025[/strike]
- 50% Completion of "Act 2" by "Update #7"
- Iteration 3 - Update #7: July 31st 2025[/p][/td][td][p]- Iteration 3 - Update #8: August 16th 2025
- 100% Completion of "Act 2" by "Update #9"
- Begin "Intermission 2" Section by "Update #9"
- Create the next roadmap in Update #9
(September, October, November)
- Iteration 3 - Update #9: August 31st 2025[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]There's not much to discuss in this update for the overall progress of the script, however I would like to mention something I have noticed since writing Act 2. The game's world opens up significantly upon reaching Act 2, which requires the script to have more elaboration going forward which may increase the time of completion on a day-to-day basis. Even when the script is completed, revisions in the building of the game digitally will be made on a case-by-case basis. What exactly do I mean by this?[/p][p]Simply put, if there's a loose end left out of the script that would harm the overall experience should I not follow up on it; I would need to revise the section to further include details from said loose end. This is all just to ensure the story I wish to tell is consistent, interesting, and most of all, exciting. The reason I bring this up now is, as mentioned earlier; Act 2 is where the game opens up drastically. Some details may fall through the cracks throughout these updates.[/p][p]We're on track to meeting our 50% goal by the end of July, and I'd say the foundations for the story are set completely and there will be plenty of surprises coming up that I'm eager putting pen to paper. Although we are on track, I am working towards surpassing 50% before the end of July; that gives us 18 Days from today until the next update. With that said, thank you for checking in on the project! We'll be seeing you once again on[b][i] July 31st, 2025 for Update #7![/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]- Lance Leeder (DevLanket)[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Iteration 3 - Update #5: June 30th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]June has already come and gone! 2025 is flying past us at a breakneck speed! With the end of June however, comes once again another update on [b][i]VOIDWATCH: CrossLust[/i][/b]! Before we begin, let's go over everything we accomplished in just a little over 2 Weeks.[/p][list][*][p]Completed the entirety of the Intermission 1 section, along with key points of interest to remember going forward into Act 2's drafts.[/p][/*][*][p]Beginning Act 2 with the first 2 pages already completed, diving more into the paranormal aspects of Brian Kendo's overall story.[/p][/*][*][p]These milestones have placed us ahead of the curve for our roadmap in place.[/p][/*][/list][p]With the early completion of these goals, a positive reevaluation of our pre-existing roadmap from May 26th is needed; the first of hopefully many. This is needed to better layout the foundation for the goals I have set in place for this project. Everything in August has now officially been moved to July, alongside brand new goals for the road ahead.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][i]To Do: June[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: July[/i][/p][/td][td][p][i]To Do: August[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][strike]- Begin "Intermission" Section

(September, October, November)
- Iteration 3 - Update #9: August 31st 2025[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]So what exactly has changed here?[/p][p]Throughout the month of July, I will be focused solely on ensuring "Act 2" is halfway to completion by the end of the month. Should I finish more, or even the entire section in the given timeframe, that'll be even better! We have 2 Updates throughout July to give progress updates on the status of "Act 2" and to evaluate potential delays depending on circumstance.[/p][p]August is a busy month for a lot of people every year, especially when you're a College or University student like myself. The latest I would like our completion of "Act 2" is in Update #9, the final update of the Summer Season. You may have noticed there is no "75% Completion" task in August, this is simply to encourage the steady completion of the section while not buffering out the roadmap; allowing the entire month to be dedicated to either finishing off the remaining 50%, or playing catchup if there were any delays in July. There are 2 Updates throughout August as well, one halfway through the month, and the other to cap off the Summer Season of 2025. That final update will consist of the completed Summer Roadmap, as well as the brand new Fall Roadmap for 2025. (September, October, and November tasks)[/p][p]More details on the tasks for the Fall Season will be given throughout Update #8 and Update #9.[/p][p]With that said, thank you for checking in on [b][i]VOIDWATCH: CrossLust[/i][/b]! I hope this year has been great to you so far! 6 Months left to go already! We'll be seeing you once again on[b][i] July 13th, 2025 for Update #6![/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]- Lance Leeder (DevLanket)[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Iteration 3 - Update #1: April 7th, 2025
notes.content:
Whether you're longtime followers of this project or newcomers, I welcome you all to the VOIDWATCH: CrossLust Steam page.

This project has been in constant development hell since April of 2022, that's roughly 3 years now. Since then a lot in my personal life has changed and I want to wish everyone an apology. I did not have my head on straight, and was emotionally unavailable to provide this project with more positive development techniques. I limited myself out of simplicity and fear that this would all be a waste of time and effort. I acknowledge my own self-esteem issues and have been working on bettering my mental health through my long absences.

The truth is, I WANT to be a developer. I WANT to make this game the ABSOLUTE BEST it can be, and I KNOW it's doable now more than ever before. I am saddened to announce I have begun a 3rd iteration of the game and its narrative. A large error on my part was writing as I developed rather than working with a complete story at the start. I can promise you all that I am in the most positive environment I have ever been placed in my entire life. I have the freedom to put everything into my passions, especially since I have completed my 2nd Year in University as of this morning. This time before September is a gift, and I wish to provide an outline of the next few months to better establish where I am with development.

To-Do: April 2025		
Complete Act 1 & Begin Intermission 1 Script
Iteration 3 - Update #2: April 28th, 2025

To-Do: May 2025
Complete Intermission 1 & Act 2 Script
Iteration 3 - Update #3: May 17th, 2025

To-Do: June 2025
Complete Intermission 2 & Act 3 Script
Iteration 3 - Update #4: June 7th, 2025
Iteration 3 - Update #5: June 28th, 2025

With each Iteration 3 Update, I will be discussing the progress of our tasks for that month and how it will be affecting the tasks ahead. In this Developer Log specifically, I will be updating you on where we stand with the script so far.

The Prologue has been rewritten entirely but still remains similar to my original drafts, with special exceptions that will be sure to hook players into the narrative through a "Hero's Journey" beginning.

With the completion of The Prologue comes better tracking of on-going plotlines, as well as a detailed list of what has been mentioned throughout the story within that section. This helps immensely with creating engaging moments for both the story and the gameplay. (ex: Brian likes alcohol, therefore potentially make him susceptible to drinks later in narrative)

Act 1 is currently written up to Page 10 of the script, greatly changing how the events kickoff the rest of the game by making minor characters more important and prominent throughout. There's no sense in getting rid of a potential long-term antagonist or introducing a semi-major character earlier on for the plot later throughout the different segments of the game.

I would love to go on with the many changes made, however this in the end will be a fully published game available here, on GameJolt, and of course on Itch.io. It's only right to keep the major changes a surprise for players!

Thank you for your patience with me, I finally figured everything out. I appreciate all of you for your support and I can assure you that you'll all be rewarded with a completed project. You shall hear from me again on April 28th, 2025 with Update #2!

-Lance Leeder (DevLanket)
